{count} name(s) in your CSV contain '?' marks (e.g. {sample}).

onboarding.title: Welcome to NREGA Bot!
onboarding.subtitle: Aapka NREGA portal automation assistant
onboarding.welcome.title: Namaste! 🙏
onboarding.welcome.desc: NREGA Bot aapke VB-G-RAM-G portal ke daily kaam automate karta hai — Demand, MR, Wagelist, Attendance, aur bahut kuch. Is chhote se tour me hum aapko 2 minute me setup kar denge.
onboarding.welcome.hint: Aap kabhi bhi About tab → 'Replay Welcome Tour' se ye tour dobara dekh sakte hain.
onboarding.lang.title: Choose Your Language
onboarding.lang.desc: Apni pasand ki language chunein — poora app turant usi bhasha me dikhega.
onboarding.browser.title: Browser Launch & Login
onboarding.browser.desc: Automation ke liye ek special Chrome window chahiye jo app control kar sake. Neeche button se wahi browser kholen.
onboarding.browser.launched: ✅ Chrome launched! Ab us window me login karein.
onboarding.browser.connected: ✅ Chrome pehle se chal raha hai — connected! Login karke 'Next' dabayein.
onboarding.browser.not_running: Chrome launch nahi hua — neeche button se kholen.
onboarding.browser.connect_failed: Chrome se connect nahi ho paya — browser dobara khol ke try karein.
onboarding.browser.login_hint: 🔐 Browser me apne official credentials se VB-G-RAM-G portal (vbgramgde2.dord.gov.in) par login karein. Login hone ke baad 'Next' dabayein.
onboarding.panch.title: Add Panchayat & Villages
onboarding.panch.desc: Aapke Block ke saare Panchayat aur unke Villages app me add karne hain — tabhi har task ke dropdowns me dikhenge. Ye button website se automatically fetch karega.
onboarding.panch.connecting: ⏳ Browser se connect ho raha hai...
onboarding.panch.done: ✅ {panch} Panchayat(s) aur {vill} Village(s) add ho gaye!
onboarding.panch.none: ⚠️ Koi Panchayat add nahi hua — aap Settings → Location Data se baad me add kar sakte hain.
onboarding.panch.skip_hint: ⏭️ Abhi nahi? Skip karke baad me Settings → Location Data se add kar sakte hain.
onboarding.stop.title: Emergency Stop Button
onboarding.stop.desc: Footer me ye red STOP button hamesha saath hota hai. Jab koi automation chalti hai, ye button red ho jata hai — click karte hi SAB kuch ruk jata hai.
onboarding.stop.caption: (Footer me ye button dikhta hai — red dot ke saath)
onboarding.stop.when1: 1️⃣ Automation galat chal rahi ho to turant rokne ke liye
onboarding.stop.when2: 2️⃣ Browser freeze ho jaye ya page atak jaye
onboarding.stop.when3: 3️⃣ Galat data enter hone se pehle sab band karna ho
onboarding.how.title: App Kaise Use Karein
onboarding.how.desc: Har automation bas 3 steps me — koi coding nahi, sab buttons se hota hai:
onboarding.how.step1: Sidebar me apna task chunein (jaise Demand, MR Fill, Wagelist)
onboarding.how.step2: Details bharein aur 'Start Automation' button dabayein
onboarding.how.step3: Progress footer me dekhein — khatam hote hi summary milega
onboarding.done.title: 🎉 Aap Taiyaar Hain!
onboarding.done.desc: Bas ho gaya! Ab aap NREGA Bot ke saare features use kar sakte hain.
onboarding.done.restart: 🔄 App abhi restart hoga taaki naye Panchayat sabhi tabs me dikhen.
